source: AI for Founders Airtable base app7lhR1V9Fts0mNc, Summit Agenda table tblJTtf6jll2UyRbW, read 14 October 2026. Airtable is the source of truth; this is a snapshot.

sessions.title: Your Calendar Is Your Ceiling
sessions.desc: You built the business to be free. Somewhere along the way it took the freedom. Vishen opens his own load map live, the years Mindvalley ran through him and what AI runs there today, then names the ceiling every founder shares: your business can't grow faster than your calendar.

sessions.title: Find Your 3 Biggest Time Drains
sessions.desc: Where do your hours actually go? Map your week live, rank where AI pays off, and leave with the three workflows to fix first, and the ones that should stay human.

sessions.title: What to Automate First
sessions.desc: Most founders try to automate everything at once and stall. Nate takes the three drains from the last session and shows how AI-native founders pick the first ones to hand over, and what those first automations look like running.

sessions.title: Your Voice, Made Executable
sessions.desc: A voice skill trained on your own words, not a template. One idea turned into a week of posts, emails and a page, with an anti-slop gate so nothing ships that sounds like AI.

sessions.title: How to Build an AI-Powered Sales Engine
sessions.desc: What becomes possible when AI is integrated across the whole sales and marketing engine: prioritising the right leads, faster follow-up, smarter nurturing, and reactivating opportunities that would otherwise be lost.

sessions.title: From Idea to Launch in a Day
sessions.desc: A Mindvalley launch used to take a team weeks. Live from the studio, Vishen takes one idea and shows AI turning it into a full campaign in a single day: what still needs a human, what AI drafts and tests, and how a founder with no marketing team can launch at the same speed.

sessions.title: Find Where Your Clients Slip Away
sessions.desc: You don't have a lead problem. You have a leak problem. Attention, lead, follow-up, sale: this session maps the journey end to end with real funnels and real numbers from two decades at Mindvalley, so you know exactly where AI should go first.

sessions.title: Turn Client Wins Into Sales
sessions.desc: Use AI to collect and place client stories on every page and email.

sessions.title: Host
sessions.flag: Starts five minutes before the previous session ends.

sessions.title: Answer Every Lead Within an Hour
sessions.desc: Firms that answer a lead within an hour are about seven times more likely to qualify it. Step by step: AI researches, qualifies, replies and books, within minutes, day or night.
sessions.flag: Speaker field says Vykintas; the description still names Liam.

sessions.title: Sell Without a Single Sales Call
sessions.desc: Mindvalley has sold more than $500 million in programmes without a sales team on the phone. Vishen shows how AI now writes, tests and improves a masterclass, a page and an email sequence, and rebuilds one founder's sales page live to find where buyers drop.

sessions.title: AI for Founders: Your Business, Rebuilt in 16 Weeks
sessions.desc: You've seen what is possible. This session shows how it gets installed in your business, one function at a time, each with a ready-made system and labs to install it.

sessions.title: One Real Business, Running on AI
sessions.desc: One founder's business running on AI from end to end: content, leads, follow-up, client delivery, each handed to AI and each with the human checkpoint kept.

sessions.title: Closing of Day 2 by Host
sessions.flag: Starts five minutes before Noelle's session ends.

sessions.title: VIP Q&A
sessions.desc: Selected founders bring a real bottleneck into a live hot seat; Vishen and Vykintas unpack it and point to the system that fixes it.

sessions.title: Plan Your First Week Off
sessions.desc: What your business needs to run for five days without you: what breaks first, what AI can hold, and what only a human can cover.

sessions.title: From AI Tools to AI Business Systems
sessions.desc: Most founders use AI to complete individual tasks faster. What becomes possible when AI moves beyond isolated tools and starts transforming how the whole business operates. Callan or a senior member of her team.

sessions.title: How Mindvalley Runs Lean With AI
sessions.desc: Where agents sit beside people at Mindvalley, what one person does today that took three before, and how the team learned to work with AI. The summit ends on teaching, not the pitch.

sessions.title: The AI-Powered CEO: What You Should and Shouldn't Be Doing Anymore
sessions.desc: AI is changing the value of a founder's time. What you should stop doing, what AI can take over, and where your time and attention create the greatest impact as a leader.

sessions.title: The Orchestrator's Week
sessions.desc: What the new way of working looks like. Two doors: the solo founder who is the business, and the founder whose team still waits on them. What each gets inside AI for Founders, and the same dated deadline.

sessions.title: Your Business on Autopilot: What Can AI Run Without You?
sessions.desc: How AI automation takes recurring work off your plate, from research and follow-ups to reporting, customer workflows and everyday operations, so more of the business keeps moving when you are not there.

sessions.title: VIP Q&A
sessions.desc: Selected founders bring a real bottleneck into a live hot seat; Vishen and Vykintas unpack it and point to the system that fixes it.
